company.name: Fictiv
company.shortDescription: Fictiv is a digital manufacturing and supply chain company that offers a digital platform for sourcing custom mechanical components.
company.description: Fictiv is the operating system (OS) for custom manufacturing that makes it faster, easier, and more efficient to source and supply mechanical parts. Their platform helps to source custom mechanical components and offers various manufacturing services, including 3D printing, CNC machining, and injection molding. They connect businesses with a global network of manufacturing partners to streamline the process of sourcing and producing parts, aiming to accelerate time to market and reduce costs.

productsAndServices.description: A digital platform for uploading CAD files, obtaining instant quotes, receiving design-for-manufacturability feedback, placing orders, and tracking custom-part production through delivery.
productsAndServices.name: Fictiv Digital Manufacturing Platform

productsAndServices.description: On-demand production of custom mechanical parts for prototypes, new product introduction, low-volume runs, and full-scale production using a managed global supplier network.
productsAndServices.name: Custom Manufacturing Services

productsAndServices.description: CNC machining for precision metal and plastic parts, including tight-tolerance components, surface finishing, and production quantities from prototypes to scale.
productsAndServices.name: CNC Machining Services

productsAndServices.description: Industrial 3D printing for rapid prototypes, functional parts, and low-volume components using FDM, SLS, SLA, PolyJet, and MJF processes.
productsAndServices.name: 3D Printing Services

productsAndServices.description: Production-grade injection molding for plastic prototypes and end-use parts, including low-volume tooling, T1 samples, and secondary operations.
productsAndServices.name: Injection Molding Services

productsAndServices.description: Custom sheet-metal fabrication for formed and finished parts such as enclosures, panels, brackets, and structural components.
productsAndServices.name: Sheet Metal Services
